channel.title: Beanie Studio — Blog
channel.description: News, development updates and playtest info for STATIC: Salvage vs Hunter.

item.title: Why sound is your only weapon
item.description: Discover how STATIC redefines roblox horror with friends. In this tense game, sound is your primary tool to evade the blind Hunter and survive the dark.

item.title: What is STATIC? Roblox horror, explained
item.description: Discover STATIC, a unique asymmetrical horror game where a hunter hunts five scrappers. Learn how this 5v1 horror game changes the genre.

item.title: Why we deleted the radar
item.description: The Hunter used to have a server-side radar. It was the most technically honest feature in the game — and we cut it anyway. Here is the design math that killed it.

item.title: Asymmetrical Horror: 1 Blind Hunter vs 5 Scrappers
item.description: Discover the asymmetrical horror game meaning in our 5v1 Roblox title. A blind hunter hunts 5 scrappers in this mobile game launching Q4 2026.
